_about: Per-card precedent/likeness values for go_generator PRECEDENT_RULE / LIKENESS_RULE, read by historical.py. Only keys listed in 'active' reach a prompt (2026-10-18: the six-render test T1-T6; the A5 roll-out adds the rest after the owner passes the test). Face features checked 2026-10-18 against the Wikipedia/Commons portraits (Adamkus official portrait: no spectacles, broad smiling face; Darius broad square face; Girenas narrower oval face; Binkis wears a tie) and corrected from the planner's draft; precedent texts name no place.
